description: The fixtures write `@spec to_thing(value) :: atom`. `value` is not a type: fz fails with resolve/type-alias (resolve.rs:390-416), and Elixir rejects it as `type value/0 undefined`. Use a real argument type, as 00099/00100 do. Owner decision D2: fz does not check an impl's spec against its protocol's spec, and elixirc doesn't either. So correct .agent/docs/protocols.md:172-176, which describes that check in the present tense, and have the fixtures' purposes say plainly that the mismatch is accepted. Proposal: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-p8p.4-findings.html (approved 2026-09-26). One commit. The fixture moves to fixtures/ and its port test is deleted in the same commit.
title: Fixtures 00422/00423 use a real type; protocols.md states the impl-spec check does not exist
